about.name: KEN ROTARIS
about.title: Full-Stack Developer
about.bio: Hello, I’m Ken, a Swiss systems-focused software engineer with 7+ years of experience across backend development, web technologies, and DevOps. I build Java-based and cloud-native systems with a strong focus on automation, maintainable code, and production reliability proven in real-world use.

projects.title: GitOps Kubernetes Homelab
projects.description: Designed and operated a GitOps-driven homelab Kubernetes platform using Argo CD, integrating identity management, secrets, certificates, ingress, CI pipelines, monitoring, and self-hosted applications to simulate a production-grade cloud-native environment.

projects.title: Speed Reading Chrome Extension
projects.description: Developed a Speed Reading Chrome extension to enhance reading speed and comprehension using text rendering techniques where the first third of the word on the current website is bolded.

projects.title: Portfolio Website
projects.description: Portfolio website featuring a React front-end and Spring backend, secured with Spring security. Plans for expanding the site include adding developer tools like a self-destruct message feature, linux cli auto completer, and a resource downtime checker to boost productivity.

projects.title: Jenkins Pipeline
projects.description: Custom CI/CD pipeline utilizing Jenkins to automate build, testing and deployment of kenrotaris.dev. This setup uses a custom Linux environment hosted on Hetzner Cloud, with Docker for operational consistency. Nginx is configured as a reverse proxy, with Modoboa handling secure, private email services, facilitating seamless development and deployment workflows.

projects.title: AI Chess Engine
projects.description: Completed a Bachelor's thesis project on solving Single-Player Chess using AI planning techniques. Compared domain-independent and domain-specific approaches to highlight their strengths and weaknesses. Developed a terminal chess user interface and implemented plan validation in Python and Java.

projects.title: Analyzing National Crime Data
projects.description: Consolidated multiple data sources into a single dataset about Crime rates, death rates and economic data in the United States. Performed data cleaning and validation on 4 GB of data, followed by comprehensive analysis and visualizations to uncover key insights.

projects.title: Arduino Project
projects.description: Constructed an LED-based Tetris game by soldering LEDs to a display screen and multiplexing them using specialized components. Utilized an Arduino for controlling the display and inputs, integrated a joystick for gameplay.

projects.title: Gnome Terminal Emulator
projects.description: Description: A C-based replica of Gnome Terminal featuring over 20 essential commands like cat, mv, ls, and mount.

projects.title: Decentralized Messenger
projects.description: Developed using Python and Tkinter, SubjectiveChat offers encrypted private and group messaging. Part of the BACnet project, it ensures reliable communication without centralized servers.

projects.title: QBasic Gorillas Clone
projects.description: An online multiplayer version of the traditional 'Gorilla' game, recreated using Java. This project allows players to connect and compete over the internet, maintaining the original gameplay mechanics while introducing modern networking features.

experience.title: aXenta
experience.description: DevOps Engineer: Modernized CI/CD and OpenShift deployments in a regulated Swiss pension software environment, cutting build times by 5x and improving reliability through automated pipelines, containerization, and continuous quality checks.

experience.title: ELCA Informatik
experience.description: Full-stack development with a focus on Java and Angular, leading the engineering of key tools including a migration tool and license management solution. Enhanced application performance and client service delivery.

experience.title: webmo
experience.description: Developed and hosted custom WordPress solutions for more than 20 clients. Managed all aspects of service delivery and client interactions.

experience.title: Zeus Supplements GmbH
experience.description: Developed a Shopware e-commerce platform and and executed successful online marketing campaigns on Google-Ads and Meta-Ads for a Fitness Supplements Company.

experience.title: Mount Vantage GmbH
experience.description: Managed operations and marketing, significantly growing a YouTube channel to a peak of 4 million subscribers and generating substantial revenue through strategic content initiatives.

education.title: Scrum Fundamentals
education.description: Covered core Scrum principles, roles, events, and artifacts, with a focus on iterative delivery, team collaboration, and applying Scrum effectively in real-world software projects.

education.title: Web Scraping in Python
education.description: Learned to extract, clean, and structure data from websites using Python, including HTTP requests, HTML parsing, and handling common scraping challenges responsibly.

education.title: Angular Training
education.description: Completed a specialized course in Angular and TypeScript, instructed by Jonas Bandi, enhancing my skills in modern web application development.

education.title: Codeingame Java Certification
education.description: Obtained a certification in Java programming from CodingGame, demonstrating proficiency in Java development and problem-solving skills.

education.title: Generative AI Fundamentals
education.description: Completed a Google Cloud course on Generative AI Fundamentals, gaining an understanding of AI technologies, large language models, and ethical AI principles.
